name: Family Reunification Temporary Residence

requirements.blocker_text: Eligible dependents are spouses, children under 18, and adopted/step-children of a sponsor holding valid Montenegrin temporary residence. Requires documentation of the family relationship and proof the sponsor holds valid temporary residence. A marriage 'entered into with the intention to achieve entry or residence' (marriage of convenience) is explicitly excluded and screened for.
requirements.fix_path: Apply with proof of the family relationship and the sponsor's valid residence status.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate or proof of parent-child relationship

outcome.duration_length: up to 1 year, or until the sponsor's permit expires (whichever is shorter)

sources.title: Government of Montenegro (gov.me) -- official Family Reunification temporary-residence category: eligible dependents, duration tied to the sponsor's permit, and the explicit marriage-of-convenience exclusion

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Montenegro). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- direct government sourcing, tier 1. GENUINE, SPECIFIC FINDING: parents and other extended family are NOT listed as eligible dependents in the source reviewed (only spouses and under-18/adopted/step-children) -- a real, sourced exclusion rather than a gap, similar to Kuwait's family-visa restriction built earlier in this dataset. work_rights set 'none' and study_rights 'restricted' since the source did not detail independent work or full school-enrollment rights for reunified dependents specifically.
